question.text: In the workbook example, net return = 13.88% on gross 20%. Fees and exit load totalled Rs. 6.12 lakh on Rs. 1 crore AUM. If we apply only post-STCG 20% tax, post-tax return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-tax return = 13.88% * (1 - 20%) = 11.10%. The Trap: Other values misapply formula. Cross-Exam Context: From Ch 10 workbook example.
